title: Chirurgie des surfaces conformes : notes manuscrites (s.d., 1983-1984), lettres (1984).

deep.reconstruction: This page has no mathematical content. It is the front of a pre-printed envelope or cover sheet from the Université des Sciences et Techniques du Languedoc, Institut de Mathématiques, Place Eugène Bataillon, 34060 Montpellier Cedex. In the middle is a handwritten name, 'Jean Pierre Dri…'. The surname is only partly legible: it may be a truncated surname or an abbreviation ending in a long descender. The archival page number '11' is pencilled at the lower left. In context the envelope probably served as a folder or divider for the surrounding notes, or held correspondence addressed to or from a person of that name. The neighbouring pages (10 and 12) carry the actual mathematics: a chain of equivalences between the following data. (1) An elliptic curve with an oriented closed geodesic modulo translations. (2) An elliptic curve with a 1-parameter real subgroup. (3) An elliptic curve with a primitive rank-1 subgroup of π₁. (4) A twisted form of G_m (Tate-curve style) with a discrete subgroup Z generated by b, 0<|b|<1, and a torsor. (5) A projective line P with a loxodromic automorphism u, i.e. non-parabolic with eigenvalues λ, λ⁻¹ and |λ|≠1. (6) A form of PGL(1)_C with a discrete non-compact cyclic subgroup. None of that is on this page.
